text:
cheng: Seeing a bunch of pods stuck in Pending in us-west2 (a/b). Autoscaler didn't spin up any GPU nodes even though the pod selectors request instance-type=gpu-preemptible. Anyone seen this today?

mike: Yup. Autoscaler logs show 'no matching node group for instance type'. Might be related to the taint/label change from last night.

cheng: I think terraform rolled out a taint 'gpu-exclusive=true:NoSchedule' which prevents non-gpu-specific pools from accepting these pods. Autoscaler is trying to scale our generic pool but the ASG mapping doesn't include the gpu-preemptible nodegroup.

lauren: Can you paste the autoscaler error line? If we need immediate relief we can create a temporary hot nodepool with different instance type (a2 or g4) via a short-lived tf resource.

cheng: logs: ```I0421 14:02:11.123456 autoscaler.go:420] NoScaleUp: no nodegroup mapping for pod selector: node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=gpu-preemptible```

sre-bot: alert: GPU scarcity in cluster-us-west2 - affected_pods=42 - severity=high

mike: Proposal: update terraform module to include an explicit autoscaler.nodeGroupMapping for gpu-preemptible and add helm values to the cluster-autoscaler chart: ```clusterAutoscaler.extraArgs: ["--node-group-auto-discovery=asg:tag=k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled,k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/our-cluster=owned"]``` Also add a fallback tf resource for a hot pool using lifecycle ignore_changes on desired_capacity.

lauren: I'll open a quick PR with a tf resource to create a temporary pool and a small helm-values patch. Need quick approval on spot vs on-demand — cost center needs flag.

cheng: @lauren please also add a small change in the helm chart values to make the gpu taint key configurable (eg. gpuTaintKey) so autoscaler can target both gpu-exclusive and gpu-shared groups without requiring a manual label hack.

mike: :thumbsup: Long term we should make the module create two GPU pools per AZ (shared + reserved) and expose a toggle. Short term hot pool + autoscaler mapping will unblock.

lauren: I'll draft the tf change now. Plan: create resource google_container_node_pool.tmphotpool with labels: {pool=hot-gpu,preemptible=true} and autoscaler tags. Will keep it timeboxed.

ops-deploy-bot: deploy started: helm upgrade cluster-autoscaler v2.0.3 -> applying extraArgs, change-id #RB-2894

mike: Heads up — switching to on-demand for the hot pool will spike cost on cost-center 3100.

cheng: Update: new hot pool is up, pods started scheduling. Autoscaler logs now show successful scale-up for the gpu mapping. I'll follow up with the PR to make the terraform module produce the dual-pool pattern and a mapping flag.
